content: Chrome Web Store user data: extensions must disclose data handling 'even when data is processed or stored locally on a users device and is not transmitted to external servers'. Privacy policy URL becomes mandatory when the extension handles user data. Per the user-data FAQ, an extension that genuinely handles no user data has 'no special or new obligations'. The Privacy practices dashboard tab is still mandatory for every submission: single purpose description, a justification for every manifest permission, a host-permission justification, a remote-code declaration, the data-usage checkbox matrix and the Limited Use certification checkboxes. Inconsistency between dashboard disclosures, the privacy policy and actual behaviour is itself a violation.
